themes.name: LLM agent security and reliability
themes.summary: These papers probe failure modes of LLM agents, including performance collapse from self-generated questions, memory-induced sycophancy, destabilization from self-generated feedback in test-time training, and reduced refusal when tools are used agentically. Proposed remedies include replayable evidence for skill evolution, counterfactual adaptation, grounded multi-agent design-time security review, and harnesses that organize computation and context for revision.

themes.name: Reinforcement learning and optimization
themes.summary: This theme spans memory-efficient RL post-training via low-rank gradient sketches and advantage-shaping policy optimization, alongside theoretical convergence and sample-complexity analyses of mirror-descent actor-critic, policy mirror descent in average-reward settings, and fitted Q-iteration for continuous-action zero-sum games. It also covers inverse RL without policy optimization and interactive imitation learning with progress-based reward models for robot recovery.

themes.name: Scientific ML and neural operators
themes.summary: These works apply machine learning across scientific domains, from autonomous generation of benchmarks for scientific agents and learned latent languages for protein generation to biomarker discovery from distilled private health records. Others build neural operators, latent transport, and denoising models for kilometer-scale downscaling, SWOT sea surface height, Earth System Model wind fields, marine tracer reconstruction, and crashworthiness prediction.

themes.name: Embodied robot learning
themes.summary: Papers here focus on vision-language-action policies, studying when to extend action chunks, perturbative training against modality shortcuts, and verifier-guided test-time scaling. They also cover world models for real-time audio-visual simulation and long-horizon video, reusable cross-embodiment dexterous manipulation primitives, and data-efficient correction of bad robot habits.

themes.name: Clinical and biomedical ML
themes.summary: This theme adapts large language models to the medical domain through RL-only domain adaptation, and applies geometric and representation-learning methods to clinical imaging such as multi-contrast MRI reconstruction, anisotropic CT segmentation, sleep staging, and gait estimation from wearable sensors. It also develops active learning, tree synthesis, and co-supervised methods for treatment effect estimation and subgroup identification.

themes.name: Diffusion and flow generative models
themes.summary: These papers advance diffusion and flow-based generation, covering adaptively looped and representation-space diffusion language models, latent reasoning with flow matching, loop flow transformers, discriminative geometry for drifting models, and proximal velocity matching for reward post-training of flow models. They also include probability-flow ODE theory and LoRA direction extraction for controllable light editing in flow-matching diffusion.

themes.name: Autonomous driving and robot navigation
themes.summary: Papers address navigation and control across settings, from context-appropriate acoustic-social navigation for quadrupeds and real-time adaptive dynamics identification for aquatic robots to UAV landing on heaving ship decks on granular slopes. Others target driving decisions via retrieval-augmented LLMs and dual-process frameworks, off-road LiDAR perception in construction, and selective spatiotemporal aggregation for 3D occupancy and scene flow.

themes.name: Video and audio generation
themes.summary: This theme covers synchronized text-to-audio-video foundation models, sparse attention for native joint video-audio generation, and efficiency trade-offs among frames, pixels, and latency in long-video understanding. It also spans causal-transition video event prediction, serial-to-parallel diffusion for physically consistent video, and analyses of motion tokenizers and verifiable rewards for temporal reasoning.

themes.name: Mechanistic interpretability and activation steering
themes.summary: These papers dissect internal model representations, reading contextual tokens in diffusion transformers, discovering interaction-aware circuits, and critically examining sparse autoencoders and their priors in vision. They also develop steering and explanation tools, including closed-loop activation steering for bias injection, concept-aware attribution, and activation alignment for tabular in-context learning.

themes.name: Human-AI interaction and social simulation
themes.summary: Papers study proactive AI assistance grounded in procedural understanding, LLM-generated preference distributions, and synthetic personas whose behavioral history predicts individual choices. Others analyze communication in multi-agent systems, tools for disclosing human-AI collaboration, comparative-evidence RL for social intelligence, and benchmarks for long-context social reasoning over discussion threads and human-agent teaming.

themes.name: Trustworthy ML: privacy, watermarking, unlearning
themes.summary: This theme addresses content authentication against deepfake generators, text leakage and gradients in split language models, gradient-free unlearning, and optimiser history contributing to forgetting. It also covers frame-aware multi-concept erasure in video diffusion, PAC-private adaptation for image synthesis, and benchmarks for watermarks and fingerprints as soft bindings for provenance.

themes.name: Graph neural networks and relational learning
themes.summary: Papers examine graph representation strategies for cyber attack detection, gated graph networks for hidden cascade dynamics, and discrete diffusion for large graph generation via structural candidate restriction. Others target relational transformers for fraud detection, over-squashing through sheaf effective resistance, variational quantum attention for molecular graphs, hypergraph representation learning, and generalization of graph edit distance models.

highlights.title: LoGRA: Scaling LLM Reinforcement Learning with Low-Rank Gradient Sketches
highlights.authors: Shaokun Zhang, Yifan Zhang, Jian Hu et al.
highlights.why: Introduces a memory-efficient RL post-training method that reduces memory by up to 45.7% and enables 27B-parameter training on a single 8-GPU node, addressing a major practical bottleneck.
highlights.key_result: With all techniques combined, LoGRA reduces average training memory usage by up to 45.7% across reasoning tasks without compromising performance, and it enables stable training of a 27B-parameter model for over 1,100 steps on a single eight-GPU node where dense Adam runs out of memory.
evidence: With all techniques combined, LoGRA reduces average training memory usage by up to 45.7% across reasoning tasks without compromising performance. It also enables stable training of a 27B-parameter model for over 1,100 steps on a single eight-GPU node, where dense Adam runs out of memory, making previously memory-infeasible RL training practical.
Over the complete runs, average memory decreases from 9.18 to 7.18 GiB at 1.5B and from 31.82 to 17.29 GiB at 7B, reductions of 21.8% and 45.7%, respectively.

highlights.title: Self-Generated Feedback Destabilizes Test-Time Training: A Causal Decomposition of Long-Horizon Adaptation
highlights.authors: Cheng Luo, Bing Li, Bernard Ghanem
highlights.why: Provides a rigorous causal decomposition showing self-generated feedback destabilizes test-time training, with clear matched comparisons and a mitigation (Settlement), crucial for long-horizon adaptation.
highlights.key_result: Retaining generated-text updates (persistent self-writing) worsens prediction on independent human-written text across 128K-token streams, adding 3.01, 6.00, and .40 nats over Writes Off at 125M, 760M, and 3B TTT-E2E scales, respectively.
evidence: Across 128K-token streams, retaining generated-text updates worsens prediction on independent human-written text with three TTT-E2E model configurations (labeled 125M, 760M, and 3B).

Retaining the updates adds 3.01, 6.00, and .40 nats over Writes Off at 125M, 760M, and 3B, respectively. Every interval excludes zero, establishing the same directional failure at all three evaluated scales.

highlights.title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation
highlights.authors: Team Kandinsky, Julia Agafonova, Bulat Akhmatov et al.
highlights.why: Presents a large synchronized audio-video foundation model with strong human evaluation results, useful for multimodal generation researchers.
highlights.key_result: The paper presents Kandinsky 6.0 Video, a family of foundation diffusion models for synchronized text-to-audio-video generation, comprising Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters), which generate 5-second video clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio and up to Full-HD (1920×1080) resolution. In side-by-side human evaluation, Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro clearly outperforms its predecessor, Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro, and remains competitive with leading audio-video generation models, particularly in speech quality.
evidence: We present Kandinsky 6.0 Video, a family of foundation diffusion models for synchronized text-to-audio-video generation, comprising Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters).

Both models generate 5-second video clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio, including lip-sync, in text-to-audio-video (T2AV) and image-to-audio-video (I2AV) modes; a built-in super-resolution model raises the output resolution to Full-HD (1920×1080).

In side-by-side human evaluation, Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro clearly outperforms its predecessor, Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro, and remains competitive with leading audio-video generation models, particularly in speech quality.

highlights.title: ALoDLM: Adaptively Looped Diffusion Language Models
highlights.authors: Liancheng Fang, Zhuowei Li, Youngeun Kim et al.
highlights.why: Proposes token-adaptive computation for diffusion language models, showing consistent gains across 11 benchmarks, which could narrow the gap to autoregressive models.
highlights.key_result: ALoDLM, trained at 1.7B and 8B scales, outperforms all evaluated diffusion language models and the corresponding AR baselines, achieving state-of-the-art average benchmark scores of 65.5 and 80.3 across eleven benchmarks while maintaining fast parallel generation, with ALoDLM-8B delivering approximately 2.7x the speed of vLLM-served Qwen3-8B on GSM8K.
evidence: Experimental results demonstrate that ALoDLM achieves state-of-the-art generation quality while maintaining fast parallel decoding. We train ALoDLM at 1.7B and 8B scales through direct SFT of Qwen3 backbones on a 5B-token corpus. In quality evaluations across eleven benchmarks spanning general reasoning, mathematics, and coding, ALoDLM achieves average scores of 65.5 and 80.3, surpassing all evaluated DLMs and the corresponding AR baselines. Furthermore, with parallel decoding on GSM8K, ALoDLM-8B delivers approximately 2.7 the speed of vLLM-served Qwen3-8B at comparable or higher accuracy, demonstrating a strong quality--efficiency trade-off.

highlights.title: Questioning the Questions: Sustaining Self-Evolution in Reasoning Models
highlights.authors: Jinyuan Li, Chengsong Huang, Langlin Huang et al.
highlights.why: Diagnoses why self-evolving reasoning models collapse from invalid and repeated self-generated questions and introduces R-Quest to sustain evolution, important for self-training pipelines.
highlights.key_result: R-Quest consistently achieves the highest average performance on 12 benchmarks in mathematical reasoning, general-domain reasoning, and code generation across two model families, and it maintains stable performance gains over ten rounds of self-evolution, peaking in the final round at 51.92 and outperforming R-Zero by 17.32 points.
evidence: Empirically, our method consistently achieves the highest average performance on 12 benchmarks in mathematical reasoning, general-domain reasoning, and code generation across two model families. Additionally, R-Quest maintains stable performance gains over ten rounds of self-evolution, peaking in the final round and outperforming R-Zero by 17.32 points.

R-Zero peaks at 49.10 in round three, then declines to 34.60 by round ten, falling below the base model's score of 46.17. In contrast, R-Quest retains its gains despite minor fluctuations between rounds: every checkpoint from rounds one through ten exceeds R-Zero's best score. R-Quest ultimately reaches its highest score of 51.92 in round ten, exceeding R-Zero by 17.32 points at the same iteration.
Across two model families, R-Quest achieves the highest domain-average scores among evaluated methods on 12 benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and general reasoning.

highlights.title: Memadapter: Counterfactual Adaptation Against Memory-induced Sycophancy
highlights.authors: Ruqing Ning, Haibo Meng, Zhishang Xiang et al.
highlights.why: Addresses memory-induced sycophancy via counterfactual adaptation, a common failure mode in long-term LLM agents.
highlights.key_result: MemAdapter consistently improves memory reliability across diverse scenarios, and on MemSyco-Bench with A-MEM it achieves 91.22% on When to Use Memory (0.44 percentage points higher than the strongest competing intervention) and 89.39% on How to Use Memory (2.33 percentage points higher).
evidence: Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that MemAdapter consistently improves memory reliability across diverse scenarios.
On MemSyco-Bench, it improves both When to Use Memory and How to Use Memory under all five memory systems.

For example, with A-MEM, MemAdapter achieves 91.22% on When to Use Memory, which is 0.44 percentage points higher than the strongest competing intervention, and 89.39% on How to Use Memory, which is 2.33 percentage points higher.

highlights.title: EVISKILL: Grounding Skill Evolution in Replayable Evidence
highlights.authors: Yan Zhou, Yili Wang, Yiwei Dai et al.
highlights.why: Grounds continual skill evolution in replayable evidence to preserve justified edits, improving reliability of experience-driven agent updates.
highlights.key_result: Experiments on three interactive benchmarks across six LLM backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach. EviSkill achieves the best accuracy in 14 of the 18 model--dataset settings and ranks among the top two methods in 16, and it improves over NoSkill in all settings, with an average gain of 17.93 percentage points; on ScienceWorld, it exceeds the strongest baseline by 15.64 points with Qwen3.5-9B and 10.43 points with GPT-5.4.

EviSkill achieves the best accuracy in 14 of the 18 model--dataset settings and ranks among the top two methods in 16. highlights.title: HelixWorld: A Real-time Interactive Audio-Visual World Model
highlights.authors: Lei Ke, Jiahao Pan, Zeyue Tian et al.
highlights.why: Delivers a real-time interactive audio-visual world model that matches silent world models and adds spatial audio, important for multisensory simulation.
highlights.key_result: We present HelixWorld, a real-time interactive audio-visual world model where visual scenes and camera-grounded spatial stereo sound co-evolve natively under user interaction. To enable low-latency causal interaction, we distill the teacher into a few-step streaming student via an online trajectory distillation loss, sustaining drift-free joint audio-visual rollouts at 24 FPS on a single GPU. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HelixWorld matches state-of-the-art silent world models in visual fidelity and responsiveness, while significantly surpassing existing baselines in camera-aligned spatial-acoustic immersion.

news.title: From Scan to Treatment Plan, AI Helps Close Breast Cancer’s Deadliest Gaps
news.summary: NVIDIA described AI applications from NVIDIA Inception startups targeting breast cancer care gaps, noting that about 40 million mammograms are performed in the U.S. annually against a projected shortfall of tens of thousands of radiologists over the next decade. iSono Health's FDA-cleared ATUSA wearable 3D ultrasound captures a standardized breast volume in approximately two minutes per breast versus up to 45 minutes for handheld ultrasound, was trained on over 1.5 million ultrasound frames, is described as 28% more sensitive than handheld 2D ultrasound, and has a 3,200-patient multicenter study underway; Whiterabbit.ai's FDA-cleared WRDensity and WRRisk address density assessment and long-term risk estimation.

news.title: RISED: Rubrics for Agentic Multi-Environment Selection and Self-Distillation
news.summary: Apple researchers presented RISED, which repurposes rubrics for online data selection and policy supervision in multi-environment agent RL: an LLM judge tags each rollout with a shared rubric vocabulary, positive rubrics supply privileged context for an on-policy self-distillation teacher, and negative rubrics steer subsequent rollout generation away from failure modes. Across model backbones RISED achieves the highest mean pass rate across environments and ranks first or second in every individual environment.

news.title: Introducing GLM 5.3 on Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: Amazon Bedrock added GLM 5.3 from Z.ai (Zhipu AI), a 753B-parameter mixture-of-experts model optimized for coding and long-horizon agentic tasks, available to eligible enterprise customers through managed APIs with cross-Region inference, prompt caching, and service tiers. The post cites a 50% improvement over GLM 5.2 on Z.ai's internal coding benchmark, a CyberGym score of 84.5, inference profiles us.zai.glm-5.3 and global.zai.glm-5.3, and Flex, Priority, and Standard tiers.

news.title: Supercharge regulated workloads with Claude Code and Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5 are available on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions, with Claude Sonnet 5 holding FedRAMP Class D (formerly High) certification and DoD Impact Level 4 and 5 authorization, and Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5 holding FedRAMP Class D certification on Amazon Bedrock. highlights.title: LoGRA: Scaling LLM Reinforcement Learning with Low-Rank Gradient Sketches
highlights.authors: Shaokun Zhang, Yifan Zhang, Jian Hu et al.
highlights.why: 提出一种内存高效的 RL 后训练方法，最多将内存降低 45.7%，并能在单个 8-GPU 节点上训练 27B 参数模型，解决了重大实际瓶颈。
highlights.key_result: With all techniques combined, LoGRA reduces average training memory usage by up to 45.7% across reasoning tasks without compromising performance, and it enables stable training of a 27B-parameter model for over 1,100 steps on a single eight-GPU node where dense Adam runs out of memory.
evidence: With all techniques combined, LoGRA reduces average training memory usage by up to 45.7% across reasoning tasks without compromising performance. It also enables stable training of a 27B-parameter model for over 1,100 steps on a single eight-GPU node, where dense Adam runs out of memory, making previously memory-infeasible RL training practical.
Over the complete runs, average memory decreases from 9.18 to 7.18 GiB at 1.5B and from 31.82 to 17.29 GiB at 7B, reductions of 21.8% and 45.7%, respectively.

highlights.title: Self-Generated Feedback Destabilizes Test-Time Training: A Causal Decomposition of Long-Horizon Adaptation
highlights.authors: Cheng Luo, Bing Li, Bernard Ghanem
highlights.why: 提供了严格的因果分解，表明自生成反馈会破坏测试时训练的稳定性，并进行清晰的匹配对比和缓解方案（Settlement），这对长程自适应至关重要。
highlights.key_result: 保留生成文本的更新（持久自写）会在独立人类书写文本的 128K token 流上恶化预测，在 125M、760M 和 3B TTT-E2E 规模下分别比 Writes Off 增加 3.01、6.00 和 .40 nats。
evidence: Across 128K-token streams, retaining generated-text updates worsens prediction on independent human-written text with three TTT-E2E model configurations (labeled 125M, 760M, and 3B).

Retaining the updates adds 3.01, 6.00, and .40 nats over Writes Off at 125M, 760M, and 3B, respectively. Every interval excludes zero, establishing the same directional failure at all three evaluated scales.

highlights.title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation
highlights.authors: Team Kandinsky, Julia Agafonova, Bulat Akhmatov et al.
highlights.why: 呈现了一个大规模同步音视频基础模型，具有出色的人工评估结果，对多模态生成研究人员很有用。
highlights.key_result: 本文提出 Kandinsky 6.0 Video，一个用于同步文本到音视频生成的基础扩散模型系列，包括 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite（3B 参数）和 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro（29B 参数），可生成 5 秒视频片段，带有同步的 44 kHz 音频和最高全高清（1920×1080）分辨率。在并排人工评估中，Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro 明显优于其前代 Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro，并与领先的音视频生成模型保持竞争力，尤其在语音质量方面。
evidence: We present Kandinsky 6.0 Video, a family of foundation diffusion models for synchronized text-to-audio-video generation, comprising Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters).

Both models generate 5-second video clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio, including lip-sync, in text-to-audio-video (T2AV) and image-to-audio-video (I2AV) modes; a built-in super-resolution model raises the output resolution to Full-HD (1920×1080).

In side-by-side human evaluation, Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro clearly outperforms its predecessor, Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro, and remains competitive with leading audio-video generation models, particularly in speech quality.

highlights.title: ALoDLM: Adaptively Looped Diffusion Language Models
highlights.authors: Liancheng Fang, Zhuowei Li, Youngeun Kim et al.
highlights.why: 为扩散语言模型提出 token 自适应计算，在 11 个基准上表现出一致的提升，这可能缩小与自回归模型的差距。
highlights.key_result: ALoDLM, trained at 1.7B and 8B scales, outperforms all evaluated diffusion language models and the corresponding AR baselines, achieving state-of-the-art average benchmark scores of 65.5 and 80.3 across eleven benchmarks while maintaining fast parallel generation, with ALoDLM-8B delivering approximately 2.7x the speed of vLLM-served Qwen3-8B on GSM8K.
evidence: Experimental results demonstrate that ALoDLM achieves state-of-the-art generation quality while maintaining fast parallel decoding. We train ALoDLM at 1.7B and 8B scales through direct SFT of Qwen3 backbones on a 5B-token corpus. In quality evaluations across eleven benchmarks spanning general reasoning, mathematics, and coding, ALoDLM achieves average scores of 65.5 and 80.3, surpassing all evaluated DLMs and the corresponding AR baselines. Furthermore, with parallel decoding on GSM8K, ALoDLM-8B delivers approximately 2.7 the speed of vLLM-served Qwen3-8B at comparable or higher accuracy, demonstrating a strong quality--efficiency trade-off.

highlights.title: Questioning the Questions: Sustaining Self-Evolution in Reasoning Models
highlights.authors: Jinyuan Li, Chengsong Huang, Langlin Huang et al.
highlights.why: 诊断了自进化推理模型为何会因无效和重复的自生成问题而崩溃，并引入 R-Quest 以维持进化，这对自训练流程非常重要。
highlights.key_result: R-Quest consistently achieves the highest average performance on 12 benchmarks in mathematical reasoning, general-domain reasoning, and code generation across two model families, and it maintains stable performance gains over ten rounds of self-evolution, peaking in the final round at 51.92 and outperforming R-Zero by 17.32 points.
evidence: Empirically, our method consistently achieves the highest average performance on 12 benchmarks in mathematical reasoning, general-domain reasoning, and code generation across two model families. Additionally, R-Quest maintains stable performance gains over ten rounds of self-evolution, peaking in the final round and outperforming R-Zero by 17.32 points.

R-Zero peaks at 49.10 in round three, then declines to 34.60 by round ten, falling below the base model's score of 46.17. In contrast, R-Quest retains its gains despite minor fluctuations between rounds: every checkpoint from rounds one through ten exceeds R-Zero's best score. R-Quest ultimately reaches its highest score of 51.92 in round ten, exceeding R-Zero by 17.32 points at the same iteration.
Across two model families, R-Quest achieves the highest domain-average scores among evaluated methods on 12 benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and general reasoning.

highlights.title: Memadapter: Counterfactual Adaptation Against Memory-induced Sycophancy
highlights.authors: Ruqing Ning, Haibo Meng, Zhishang Xiang et al.
highlights.why: 通过反事实适应解决记忆引发的谄媚行为，这是长期 LLM 智能体中常见的失效模式。
highlights.key_result: MemAdapter 在不同场景下一致地改善记忆可靠性；在 MemSyco-Bench 上使用 A-MEM 时，它在何时使用记忆（When to Use Memory）上达到 91.22%（比最强竞争干预高 0.44 个百分点），在如何使用记忆（How to Use Memory）上达到 89.39%（高 2.33 个百分点）。
evidence: Extensive experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate that MemAdapter consistently improves memory reliability across diverse scenarios.
On MemSyco-Bench, it improves both When to Use Memory and How to Use Memory under all five memory systems.

For example, with A-MEM, MemAdapter achieves 91.22% on When to Use Memory, which is 0.44 percentage points higher than the strongest competing intervention, and 89.39% on How to Use Memory, which is 2.33 percentage points higher.

highlights.title: EVISKILL: Grounding Skill Evolution in Replayable Evidence
highlights.authors: Yan Zhou, Yili Wang, Yiwei Dai et al.
highlights.why: 将持续技能进化建立在可重放证据之上，以保留合理的编辑，从而提高经验驱动智能体更新的可靠性。
highlights.key_result: Experiments on three interactive benchmarks across six LLM backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach. EviSkill achieves the best accuracy in 14 of the 18 model--dataset settings and ranks among the top two methods in 16, and it improves over NoSkill in all settings, with an average gain of 17.93 percentage points; on ScienceWorld, it exceeds the strongest baseline by 15.64 points with Qwen3.5-9B and 10.43 points with GPT-5.4.
evidence: Experiments on three interactive benchmarks across six LLM backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach.

EviSkill achieves the best accuracy in 14 of the 18 model--dataset settings and ranks among the top two methods in 16. It improves over NoSkill in all settings, with an average gain of 17.93 percentage points. On ScienceWorld, it exceeds the strongest baseline by 15.64 points with Qwen3.5-9B and 10.43 points with GPT-5.4.

highlights.title: HelixWorld: A Real-time Interactive Audio-Visual World Model
highlights.authors: Lei Ke, Jiahao Pan, Zeyue Tian et al.
highlights.why: 提供了一个实时交互式音视频世界模型，可与无声世界模型相媲美并增加空间音频，对多感官模拟很重要。
highlights.key_result: 我们提出 HelixWorld，一个实时交互式音视频世界模型，其中视觉场景和以相机为基准的空间立体声在用户交互下原生地共同演化。为实现低延迟因果交互，我们通过在线轨迹蒸馏损失将教师模型蒸馏为少步流式学生模型，在单个 GPU 上以 24 FPS 保持无漂移的联合音视频推演。大量实验表明，HelixWorld 在视觉保真度和响应性上可与最先进的无声世界模型相媲美，同时在相机对齐的空间声学沉浸感上显著超过现有基线。
evidence: We present HelixWorld, a real-time interactive audio-visual world model where visual scenes and camera-grounded spatial stereo sound co-evolve natively under user interaction.

To enable low-latency causal interaction, we distill the teacher into a few-step streaming student via an online trajectory distillation loss, sustaining drift-free joint audio-visual rollouts at 24 FPS on a single GPU.

Extensive experiments demonstrate that HelixWorld matches state-of-the-art silent world models in visual fidelity and responsiveness, while significantly surpassing existing baselines in camera-aligned spatial-acoustic immersion.

news.summary: AWS 介绍了 Quick Resource Migrator，一个托管在 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime 上的示例幂等 MCP 服务器，可在单次工具调用中自动跨账户提升 Amazon Quick 资源（智能体、操作连接器、知识库、流程和空间）。该迁移器执行 upsert 而不会对目标执行删除操作，在每次更改前将带版本的备份写入 Amazon S3，并提供对运行将创建或更新内容的只读预览。
